\section{Overview}\label{sec:overview}
A reusable configuration file keeps routine processing predictable and easy to inspect.

A new validation step reports the selected profile before processing begins.

\begin{figure}\includegraphics{new-preview.pdf}\caption{A changed preview asset that is ignored.}\end{figure}

\section{Workflow}
The process has four stages. Each stage emits a status message and a validation result.

\begin{itemize}
\item Read the input file.
\item Normalize the values.
\item Validate the selected profile.
\end{itemize}

The normalized score is $s = q/t$.

\begin{equation}
R = \frac{accepted}{received + skipped}
\end{equation}
